changeSet.sql:
create or alter function [utility].[GetIntersectTypesByType] ( @assetTypeUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select top 100 'I' as type, * from ( select Uid, cast(Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + cast(ObjectUid as varchar(36)) + '|2' as value, coalesce( UPPER(LEFT(PredicateName, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(PredicateName, 2, LEN(PredicateNAME))), 'relates to' ) + ' ' + ObjectName + ' (->)' as title from IntersectTypeDetail where SubjectUid = @assetTypeUid
union
select Uid, cast(Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + cast(SubjectUid as varchar(36)) + '|1' as value, coalesce( UPPER(LEFT(PredicateInverse, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(PredicateInverse, 2, LEN(PredicateInverse))), 'related to' ) + ' ' + SubjectName + ' (<-)' as title from IntersectTypeDetail where ObjectUid = @assetTypeUid ) O order by title )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE or ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetIntersectTypesByType] ( @type varchar(50), @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select top 100000 * from ( select 'I' as type, I.uid, cast(I.Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Subject and ObjectID = I.SubjectID) as varchar(36)) + '|' + '|2' as value, coalesce( UPPER(LEFT(P.Name, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Name, 2, LEN(P.NAME))), 'Relates to' ) + ' ' + I.SubjectName + '(->)' as title from IntersectTypeDetail I left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID where Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id and Object = @type and ObjectID = @id union select 'I' as type, i.Uid, cast(i.Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Object and ObjectID = I.ObjectID) as varchar(36)) + '|1' as value, coalesce(UPPER(LEFT(P.Inverse, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Inverse, 2, LEN(P.Inverse))), 'Related to') + ' ' + I.ObjectName + '(<-)' as title from IntersectTypeDetail I left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID where Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id and Object = @type and ObjectID = @id union select 'I' as type, i.Uid, cast(i.Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + case when (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) then cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Object and ObjectID = I.ObjectID) as varchar(36)) + '|2' else cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Subject and ObjectID = I.SubjectID) as varchar(36)) + '|1' end as value, case when (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) then coalesce(UPPER(LEFT(P.Name, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Name, 2, LEN(P.Name))), 'Relates to') +' ' + I.ObjectName + '(->)' else coalesce(UPPER(LEFT(P.Inverse, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Inverse, 2, LEN(P.Inverse))), 'Related to') + ' ' + I.SubjectName + '(<-)' end as title from IntersectTypeDetail I left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID where ( (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) or (Object = @type and ObjectID = @id) ) and Subject + cast(SubjectID as varchar) <> Object + cast(ObjectID as varchar) union select 'I' as type, i.Uid, cast(i.Uid as varchar(36)) + '|' + case when (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) then cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Object and ObjectID = I.ObjectID) as varchar(36)) else cast((SELECT uid from AssetType WHERE Object = I.Subject and ObjectID = I.SubjectID) as varchar(36)) end + '|0' as value, case when (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) then coalesce(UPPER(LEFT(P.Name, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Name, 2, LEN(P.Name))) + ' / ' + UPPER(LEFT(P.Inverse, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Inverse, 2, LEN(P.Inverse))), 'Relates to / Related to') + ' ' + I.ObjectName + '(<->)' else coalesce(UPPER(LEFT(P.Name, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Name, 2, LEN(P.Name))) + ' / ' + UPPER(LEFT(P.Inverse, 1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(P.Inverse, 2, LEN(P.Inverse))), 'Relates to / Related to') + ' ' + I.SubjectName + '(<->)' end as title from IntersectTypeDetail I left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID where (Subject = @type and SubjectID = @id) or (Object = @type and ObjectID = @id) ) O order by title )
